# criblio_custom_banners (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_custom_banners" "example" {
  group_id = "default"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Worker group ID.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `created` (Number) Timestamp (in Unix time) when the Banner was created.
- `custom_themes` (List of String) List of custom theme identifiers available for the Banner.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Display the Banner to all users.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Banner.
- `invert_font_color` (Boolean) Invert the Banner text color for better contrast against the background.
- `link` (String) Optional URL to append to the Banner message as a clickable link.
- `link_display` (String) Optional display label for the link URL. When provided, the Banner shows this text instead of the raw URL. Limited to 100 characters.
- `message` (String) Message text to display in the Banner, visible to all users across all Cribl products. Limited to 100 characters.
- `theme` (String) Background color for the Banner. Use a supported theme name or a hexadecimal color value.
- `type` (String) Type of Banner. Custom Banners are user managed. System Banners are managed by Cribl.
